source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Firewalls' (PDF 20): the same text in simple Roman Urdu with glossed hard words, a self-check and a recap.

blocks.text: Firewall ek security device ya software hai. Yeh incoming (andar aane wale) aur outgoing (bahar jane wale) network traffic ko control karta hai. Firewalls harmful (nuqsan deh) ya unwanted (na-pasandeeda) data ko block karte (rok dete) hain (jaise Figure 1.17 mein). Yeh safe (mehfooz) aur unsafe networks ke darmiyan barrier (deewar) ka kaam karte hain. Firewalls computers ko attacks (hamlon) se bachate hain. Yeh gharon aur offices mein istemal hote hain.

blocks.alt: Baayen taraf aag se laal teer aate hain jo eenton ki deewar par ruk jate hain, jis par sabz tick wali neeli dhaal (shield) hai; deewar se sabz teer daayen taraf computer tak jate hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 1.17: Firewall ki hifazat (kitab ki Figure 1.17 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Firewall school ke gate ke chowkidar jaisa hai: jaane pehchane aur ijazat wale log andar aa sakte hain, baqi ko gate par hi rok diya jata hai.

blocks.explanation: Network mein aane aur jane wale traffic ko control karta hai aur nuqsan deh ya na-pasandeeda data ko rok deta hai; mehfooz aur ghair mehfooz networks ke darmiyan deewar.

items: Firewall: device ya software; andar/bahar ka traffic control; nuqsan deh data block; hamlon se bachao.
